'''Elder Blackmaw''' is a furbolg of the Groveweald tribe located in the [[Crescent Grove]] that accompanies [[Grovetender Engryss]] alongside [[Elder 'One Eye']].

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Paw of Elder Blackmaw]] for {{Neutral}} [34D] [[The Unwise Elders]].
* Drops [[Groveweald Badge]] for {{Neutral}} [33D] [[The Rampant Groveweald]].
